about: Featured local partners for county pages (counties/<st>/<county>.html). A partner shows only when status is "featured", meaning the nonprofit has agreed to be featured. Use "proposed" to stage an entry without showing it. Each entry: id, name, state (two-letter code), counties (names exactly as in the state's county office file), status, blurb (one or two plain sentences), website (https), optional phone, reviewed_on (YYYY-MM-DD).
